entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 9199 of 2023
Applicant :- Vinod Kumar
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Ganga Prasad Mishra
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1.

Heard Sri Ganga Prasad Mishra, the learned counsel for the applicant as well as Sri Alok Singh,
the learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

2. The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
850 of 2019, under Section 419, 420, 467, 468, 471, 506 I.P.C., registered at Police Station Kotwali
Nagar, District Gonda.

3.  The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of F.I.R. lodged on 04.11.2019, against four persons, including the applicant, alleging that the informant had purchased 0.09 decimal land forming part of Khasra No. 148 A from Dharamraj, father of he applicant on 06.02.1992 but subsequently, the applicant fraudulently sold away the same land again, to co-accused Dharamraj by means of a sale -deed dated 02.01.2013.
4.
In the affidavit filed in support of the bail application, it has been stated that the applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in the present case.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It has further been stated in the affidavit that the land sold by the applicant to co-accused Dherajanand forms a part of Gata No. 148 and not Gata No. 148A.
A copy of relevant extract of khatauni has been annexed in support of this contention.

6. In Para 12 and 13 of the affidavit, the applicant's involvement in Case Crime No. 61 of 2016 under Section 380/457 I.P.C has been disclosed and the learned counsel for the applicant has stated that it has been disclosed as it has been mentioned in the bail rejection order passed by the Sessions Judge and the applicant has not been summoned in this case.

On the basis of the applicant's involvement in the present case, he has been implicated in Case Crime No. 261 of 2023 under Section 3(1) of U.P.
Gangsters and Anti Social Activities (Prevention) Act, Police Station Kotwali District Gonda, in which the applicant has filed an application for grant of bail, which is pending consideration of the Sessions Judge, Gonda.

entities.text:
U.P.
Gangsters and Anti Social Activities (Prevention) Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 7. The learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer of the bail, but he could not dispute the aforesaid aspects of the matter.

8. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and coupled with the fact that the applicant is languishing in jail since 30.06.2023 and without making any observations which may affect the merits of the case, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for enlargement of the applicant on bail.
9. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.

10. Let the applicant- Vinod Kumar be released on bail in Case Crime No. 850 of 2019, under Section 419, 420, 467, 468, 471, 506 I.P.C., registered at Police Station Kotwali Nagar, District Gonda, on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of Magistrate/Court concerned, subject to the following conditions: -
(i) the applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence;
(ii) the applicant shall not pressurize the prosecution witnesses;
(iii) the applicant shall appear on each and every date fixed by the trial court.
11. In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the prosecution shall be at liberty to move bail cancellation application before this Court.
(Subhash Vidyarthi,J.) Order Date :- 21.7.2023 Preeti.
 
Vinod Kumar vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.
